questions.question: Explain what makes 18 plus 24 equals box a number sentence and what the box means.
questions.expected_answer: It has numbers, an operation sign and an equals sign, so it is a complete statement rather than just an expression. It is an open sentence because the box stands for a number that is not yet known, the total of 18 and 24.

questions.question: Sipho has 19 marbles and Lerato has 27. Write the number sentence for how many more Lerato has, and explain why it is not an addition.
questions.expected_answer: The sentence is 27 minus 19 equals box. Although the word more appears, the question asks for the difference between the two amounts, and finding a difference is subtraction.

questions.question: A customer buys bread for R18 and milk for R24 and pays with R50. Write the number sentence for the change and explain the brackets.
questions.expected_answer: 50 minus 18 plus 24 in brackets equals box. The brackets show that the bread and milk are added first to get the total spent, and that total is then taken from R50 to give the change.
